approvers: Owner/director, plus the client or main contractor on the job
reason: ACHV is a contractor too, and I don't want a competitor on my site or seeing my programme. At about €19 per m² it also costs more than a cheap film or tape, and we spend only about €800 a year on this, so it isn't worth the paperwork.
objection: A competing contractor on my site, seeing my programme and my clients, plus a 50% deposit and a credit application just to start.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape, applied by my own lads, and keep the glazing damage claims in the snagging list.
would_change_my_mind: A neutral, non-contracting applicator, no deposit on a small job, and a local reference from a contractor my size showing fewer glazing claims.
